setting: Hoenn, 25 years after an Emerald/ORAS-inspired reimagined history
structural_rule: Open-order 8 gyms; trainer team variants chosen by badges; main storyline advances independent of gym order
opening: Mossdeep evacuation (map design must be completed before event scripting)
factions: Neo Magma - successor led by Maxie's child
Neo Aqua - successor led by Archie's child
Team Null - ranger/conservation intervention group led by May; exact history involving Birch and Norman unresolved
people: Professor Birch missing; moved newer lab to Mauville before disappearance
Norman has been missing for 15 years; Wally succeeded him at Petalburg Gym
Steven, Wallace, Giovanni, and Tate & Liza proposed for Elite Four; specifics not locked
